description: Strong public capacity coordinates infrastructure housing climate digital systems and social protection.
Land and housing systems are shaped by speculation while public value capture remains weak.
Digital systems are governed through audits rights cybersecurity and public accountability.
Climate adaptation governance manages flood heat insurance ecological buffers and exposed housing.
Institutions recognize informal systems while improving tenure services and safety.
Legacy systems require maintenance-first planning and long-term repair finance.
Fragmented authority weak finance and low trust limit urban transformation capacity.
Formal institutions lag behind population growth informal systems and service demand.
